comment: Merge gate config for tim4net/jukebox-tv. Risky-path globs are Bob's exact spec (Del thread, 2026-11-20 ~23:26 CST) — do not widen or narrow them without Bob. Flag ONLY Jukebox publish/signing/updater paths and Jukebox architecture, not the whole upstream SmartTube tree.

mutation.comment: PIT mutation check (Bob's spec §b). Runs on the `mutate` label and nightly — NEVER on every push, and never attached to build-apks.yml. Threshold: no surviving mutant on a changed line; if line-level cannot be computed, mutation score >= 80% on changed classes with every survivor listed.

categories.description: CI publish / release — build-apks.yml is the Jukebox publish path (signing secrets JUKEBOX_KEYSTORE_*, update manifest, intended R2 upload); CI.yml writes keystore.properties from SIGNING_KEY secrets; make-update-manifest.sh builds latest.json
categories.name: ci-publish

categories.description: signing — keystore files and the signingConfigs owner (smarttubetv/build.gradle owns signingConfigs, BuildConfig fields, applicationId, the stjukebox flavor)
categories.name: signing

categories.description: build config — Gradle build files (common/build.gradle, root build.gradle, settings.gradle, gradle.properties)
categories.name: build-config

categories.description: updater endpoint — update_urls.xml is the on-device updater endpoint (https://jukebox.tfour.net/install/latest.json)
categories.name: updater

categories.description: Jukebox architecture — room client/protocol and the stjukebox manifest
categories.name: architecture

riskyPaths.comment: A match adds the `needs-bob` label and a comment; it never fails the gate. A test-only change on a risky path still flags (Bob's spec). R2 or other publish credentials may appear only in the workflow's publish step — never in the app, BuildConfig, Gradle buildConfigFields, logs, or source.
